criteria.text: It exits 0 on this commit, where both versions agree

edits.tools/version_check.py:
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
pkg = json.loads((ROOT / "package.json").read_text())["version"]
line = next(l for l in (ROOT / "skill" / "bin" / "fleet").read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith("VERSION = "))
cli = re.search(r'"([^"]+)"', line).group(1)
print(f"package.json {pkg}, skill/bin/fleet {cli}")
sys.exit(0 if pkg == cli else 1)
